# pltr context

Compact summaries of a dataset, folder or ontology for writing code against it (Markdown, or --format json); --fixture-dir writes samples for tests.

3 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

### pltr context dataset

[beta] What a dataset holds: columns, sample rows, schedules, latest job.

`pltr context dataset DATASET_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `DATASET_RID` (RID or path): Dataset RID to describe.
- `--rows` INTEGER (default: 5): Sample rows or objects to fetch (at most 1000).
- `--columns` TEXT: Comma-separated columns for the sample rows (default: the first 12).
- `--branch` TEXT: Branch (default: the default).
- `--fixture-dir` PATH: Also write the samples to this directory for tests (never over an existing file).
- beta · SDK: `filesystem.Resource.get`, `datasets.Dataset.get_schema`, `datasets.Dataset.read_table`, `datasets.Dataset.get_schedules`, `datasets.Dataset.jobs`, `orchestration.Job.get`

### pltr context folder

The resources under a folder or project: type, path and RID.

`pltr context folder FOLDER_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `FOLDER_RID` (RID or path): Folder or project RID to describe.
- `--depth` INTEGER (default: 1): Levels of subfolders to list.
- SDK: `filesystem.Folder.children`

### pltr context ontology

[beta] Object types (keys, properties, links), and their actions and queries.

`pltr context ontology ONTOLOGY [OPTIONS]`

- `ONTOLOGY`: Ontology RID or API name.
- `--types` TEXT: Comma-separated object types to describe in full (default: a summary).
- `--rows` INTEGER (default: 5): Sample rows or objects to fetch (at most 1000).
- `--fixture-dir` PATH: Also write the samples to this directory for tests (never over an existing file).
- beta · SDK: `ontologies.Ontology.get_full_metadata`, `ontologies.OntologyObject.list`
